note: Read by tools/restructure/browser-move.mjs. `homes`: the folder of a feature when it is not named like the feature (as in move-left.json). `features` and `files`: loose scripts of server/js/ that stay where they are on purpose, each with the reason the report prints. `lists`: scripts whose strings are the addresses of a page the engine writes when the page is asked for, so they are rewritten with a move like a script tag.

features.engine-core: a shared root: every page and every feature loads it, and it belongs to none
features.words: a shared root: every page and every feature loads it, and it belongs to none (Xenon Maker also reads i18n.js by this path)
features.helpers-shared: a shared root: every page and every feature loads it, and it belongs to none

files.server/js/main.js: the script every page starts from; `js/main.js` is also the name widget packages give their own entry, and the two cannot be told apart in a note or a test
